sonnet.problem: The right answer says Aaron and Hur set the stone under Moses and held his hands up. Verse 12 says only that 'they took a stone and put it under him'. It does not say who 'they' are. It names Aaron and Hur only for holding his hands up. The question and answer assign the stone to Aaron and Hur, which closes something the text leaves open.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
